question: Question, Odacchi! Ace ate the Mera Mera no Mi so he can... *(1) "Can turn his body into flame"? *(2) "Can shoot flame from his body", which one is it?
answer: The answer is (1). But his secret move "Hiken" (Fire Fist) is a skill where he raises his "firepower" and turns his fist into a huge flame, so it ends up looking more like (2).
